Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Shape: Glass shape. morph: blob that morphs between sphere and rounded cube. torus: ring. cube: rounded cube.
Ior: Index of refraction. 1 = no bend; higher bends the background more (glass is about 1.5).
Dispersion: Spread of IOR between the R, G and B channels. 0 = none, higher gives stronger chromatic colour fringes.
Frost: Blur of the refracted background, like frosted glass. 0 = clear.
Size: Scale of the glass shape. 1 = default; also scales the refraction strength.
Morphspeed: Whole number of morph cycles per 8-second animation loop. 0 = no morphing.
Spin: Whole number of full rotations per 8-second animation loop. 0 = no spin.
Highlights: Gain of the specular, fresnel and glint highlights. 0 = none.
Absorption: Thickness-based tint: thicker glass darkens and colours the refracted image more. 0 = none.
Camdistance: Camera distance from the shape in world units. Larger makes the shape smaller on screen.
Bgscale: Scale of the background mapping. Larger values reduce the refraction offset of the background.
Modamount: Strength of the in2 modulation CHOP: band1 adds Modamount * band1 * 0.5 to Ior.
